color.description: Enable color output (default true). Set to false to disable (--nocolor).

noprompt.description: Exit after search without entering omniprompt.

expand.description: Expand URLs to full domains (default true); use -x to force expand.

num.description: Number of results per page (0–25; 0 disables fixed paging).

colors.description: Six-letter ANSI color string for indices, titles, URLs, metadata, abstracts, prompt.

url_handler.description: Custom command or script to open URLs (overrides default handler).

commands.description: Array of explicit ddgr command-line overrides (each item is a dict with 'key' and 'value'). Used to specify options not covered by top-level flags, or multiple --site, --reg, etc., in a single config. Each object must have 'key' and may have 'value'. 'key' must be a documented long/short option (e.g., '--num', '-r', '--colors'). 'value' is the argument string (e.g., '20', 'in-en', 'bjdxxy'). If the option takes no argument (e.g., '--unsafe'), set 'value' to '' or omit it. Not required for flags covered by top-level bool/enum fields; use only when multiple instances or non-standard options are needed.
